post.description: Copies the scheduled lessons of a school day, or of a week from Monday to Sunday, to another day or week in one transaction. Each copy is a one-off lesson at the same school-local wall-clock time, with the course type, room, staff, length, capacity, kind and visibility of its source and no bookings. Canceled lessons are not copied. A source lesson is skipped with a reason: `class-slot` when its class has a slot in the target week within its term (generation makes that lesson), `started` when the copy would not start in the future, `staff-inactive` when its instructor or accompanist is no longer active, and `room-taken` when another lesson that is not canceled, a lesson of a class that generation has not created yet, or an earlier copy of the same clone uses the room at an overlapping time, checked in this order. Nothing is changed or deleted, and nobody is mailed. A week's dates must be Mondays (422 on `body.source` or `body.target`); a target equal to the source or before today (a week: its Monday) is a 422 on `body.target`.
post.summary: Clone a day or a week

post.description: Returns what `cloneLessons` would create and skip now, without changing anything.

Sets the password with the token from the reset link and ends every session of the account; it does not sign in. An unknown, used or expired link is a 410.
post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Creates a member account and mails a confirmation link to the email address. The answer is the same whether the address is new or already registered. Too many mail requests per client are a 429 with Retry-After.

Sets an active booking to `attended`, `no_show` or back to `booked` (unknown). From the lesson's start on (before it a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `not-started`), until the end of its school day for instructors and accompanists (afterwards a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over`), at any time after the start for the office. Each change adds a booking event. A canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`, a lesson the school canceled a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`.

Cancels a booking of the signed-in person or one of their dependents (404 for any other booking) and frees its place. A booking canceled already is a 409 `already-canceled`; one whose lesson has started a 422 on `path.bookingId`. From the cancellation cutoff before the start on, the cancellation is allowed but `late`, unless the school canceled the lesson. The signed-in account gets a mail.

get.description: Returns what `cancelFollowing` would cancel now with `until`, without changing anything, and fails like it (an `until` before the lesson's date is a 422 on `query.until`). Without `until`, the response names the default: the last day of the class's term.

parameters.description: Last slot date to cancel; default: the last day of the class's term.
parameters.name: until

schema.description: Last slot date to cancel; default: the last day of the class's term.

post.description: Cancels a booking of a class lesson together with the same person's other active bookings of that class from this lesson on up to the slot date `until` (default: the last day of the class's term) whose lessons have not started, in one transaction, each `late` like in `cancelBooking`. A person who is a member of the class stays one but is paused until then: they are booked automatically again only into the lessons after it (`pausedUntil`). A booking of a one-off lesson, or one whose lesson has started, is a 422 on `path.bookingId`; an `until` before the lesson's date a 422 on `body.until`; a canceled booking a 409 `already-canceled`; any other person's a 404. The signed-in account gets one mail listing every canceled booking.

put.description: Sets whether an active booking is a trial, and its note for the instructor (a note without `trial` is a 422 on `body.trialNote`). Same access and time window as `addLessonParticipant` (a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over` once the day is over for instructors); a canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`.

post.description: Cancels a booking of the lesson as staff: never late, and a person's date is released, so a later change of their class membership does not book them into it again. Its place goes to the waiting list. After the start too (a walk-in added by mistake), until the end of the lesson's school day for instructors and accompanists (afterwards a 422 on `path.bookingId` with reason `day-over`), at any time for the office, and on a lesson the school canceled. Before the start of a lesson that takes place, the participant's mail recipients get the cancellation; for a canceled lesson nobody is mailed or invited. A canceled booking is a 409 `already-canceled`; a booking of a lesson of others a 404.

delete.description: Deletes a class with its lessons while none of them has started or been booked (automatic bookings of former members aside) and it has no members; otherwise it is a 409 `in-use` and can be retired instead.

put.description: Replaces the fields of a class; its term stays. The future lessons that were not edited one by one follow, with their bookings; a capacity below the class's member count or the bookings of one of them is a 422 on `capacity`. A retired class generates no more lessons and leaves the public timetable; its future lessons that still follow it and have no bookings but the automatic ones of class members are deleted with those.

post.description: Enrolls a person in a class and books them into the class's lessons from `since` on that have not started, canceled ones included, even beyond a lesson's capacity, unless they have a booking for the lesson already (one canceled when an earlier membership ended aside). An unknown person is a 422 on `personId`, a person who is a member already a 409 `duplicate`, a retired class a 422 on `path.classId`, and a class whose members fill its capacity a 409 `full`.

delete.description: Ends a person's membership in a class and cancels their bookings of the class's lessons that have not started, without a mail; a person who is not a member is a 404.

put.description: Replaces the dates of a membership: `since` and the end of a pause, `pausedUntil` (left out: not paused, which ends a pause). Then books the member into the class's lessons that have not started and that they are active on but have no booking for, as `addClassMember` does (a date they released stays released), after canceling their automatic bookings of those they are no longer active on (a new pause, a later `since`), without a mail. A person who is not a member is a 404, a retired class a 422 on `path.classId`.

get.description: Returns all course types (dance styles) ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a course type. A name another course type has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a course type that no class or lesson uses; a used one is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and description of a course type; its classes and lessons show the new name. A name another course type has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Lists fictional demo accounts, one per role, with their password. Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.
Lists the newest mails of the outbox, so that the demo, which delivers no mail, can show them (e.g. the confirmation link). Only in a demo installation; otherwise a 404.

Returns the signed-in person and their dependents (usually children without their own login), each with its other guardians. A managed dependent, one with its own account or a staff link, is read-only here.

post.description: Creates a person (a child without their own login) with the signed-in person as guardian.

delete.description: Ends the signed-in person's guardianship. A dependent left without a guardian is deleted, unless it is managed (it stays); while it has bookings or class memberships, that is a 409 `in-use` and nothing changes. Anyone else's person is a 404.

put.description: Replaces the name, phone and birth date of one of the signed-in person's dependents. A managed dependent is a 409 `managed`; anyone else's person is a 404.
Replaces the signed-in person's name, phone and birth date.

get.description: Reports that the service is running and which version is deployed.

post.description: Adds a lesson without a class, e.g. a workshop or a private lesson, which are published early; a regular one follows the release window. An unknown course type, room or staff member is a 422 on the field that names it. A start that is not in the future is a 409 `past` unless `confirmPast` is set. Another lesson in the room at an overlapping time is a 409 `room-taken` naming it, unless `confirmRoomOverlap` is set.

delete.description: Deletes a one-off lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise) and that no booking refers to (409 `in-use` otherwise). A lesson of a class is canceled instead (409 `generated`): generation would create it again.

get.description: Returns one lesson the caller may see (see getSchedule), with its free places and, for a signed-in caller, whom of their family it has booked. Lessons that do not exist or are not visible are reported alike as not found. Office and admin accounts also get `admin`: the detached flag, the active bookings and the cancellation details.

put.description: Replaces the time, room, staff, capacity, visibility and kind of a lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise); course type and class stay. A lesson of a class is detached from it: class and term edits leave it alone from then on. A capacity below the active bookings is a 422 on `capacity`. A new start in the past is a 409 `past` unless `confirmPast` is set. A new time or room is checked like in `createLesson` (409 `room-taken`). A new start or room of a scheduled lesson mails everyone with an active booking, unless it now starts in the past.

post.description: Sets every booking of the lesson whose attendance is unknown (`booked`) to `attended`, under the rules of `setAttendance` (the 422s on `path.lessonId` with reason `not-started` or `day-over`), and returns the bookings it changed.

Books the lesson for the signed-in person or one of their dependents (managed ones included). A person outside the family, or a lesson the caller may not see, is a 404. Everyone books under member rules: staff get a 409 `closed` with why `release` for a lesson members may not book yet (not released, beyond their early access) or at all (hidden). A canceled lesson is a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`, one that has started a 409 `closed` with why `started`, and one whose booking cutoff has passed a 409 `closed` with why `cutoff`, checked in this order. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`, a lesson whose active bookings fill its capacity a 409 `full`. The signed-in account gets a confirmation mail.

Cancels a lesson that has not started (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise), with an optional note, and mails everyone with an active booking. The bookings stay. A canceled lesson stays as it is, note included, started or not.

Mails the plain-text `message` (line breaks normalized to `\n`, trimmed, 1 to 1000 characters, no control characters but line breaks and tabs, no invisible format characters but the zero-width joiners; a 422 on `body.message` otherwise) to everyone booked for the lesson: the mail recipients of every active booking and the guests with an email, each address once, each in its language. The mail names the sender as the schedule does if they teach or accompany the lesson, else by their name, and replies go to the sender's address (the admin's while signed in as someone else). Same access as `listLessonParticipants` (a 404 on others' lessons); lessons that are over or canceled too. An account sends at most 5 notices an hour, and a lesson gets at most 3 a school day, from anyone: beyond that a 429 with `Retry-After`. Returns how many addresses were mailed; a lesson without any counts no notice.

get.description: Returns every booking of the lesson, canceled ones included, with the participant's name and contact data, and its waiting list, ended entries included, with the counts. The office sees every lesson, an instructor or accompanist the lessons they teach or accompany (their staff record linked to their person); any other lesson is a 404.

post.description: Books a person (`personId`) or a guest (`guest`, a name and an optional email) into the lesson as staff (source `staff`), optionally as a `trial` with a `trialNote`. Unlike `bookLesson`, the release window and the booking cutoff do not apply, and the lesson may have started: instructors and accompanists add until the end of the lesson's school day (afterwards a 422 on `path.lessonId` with reason `day-over`), the office at any time. A lesson the school canceled is a 409 `closed` with why `canceled`. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`; a lesson whose active bookings and the places held by others' waiting-list invites fill its capacity a 409 `full`, unless `confirmOverCapacity` is set (the booking event records the override). A person whose own invite holds a place takes it without the confirmation (an override if the lesson has been overbooked since); any other entry of the person on the lesson's waiting list ends. Before the lesson starts, the person's mail recipients, or a guest with an email (in the school's language, asked to contact the school to cancel), get the confirmation. Lessons of others are a 404, an unknown person a 422 on `body.personId`.

Lets a canceled lesson that has not started take place after all (422 on `path.lessonId` otherwise) and mails everyone with an active booking its current time and room. Another lesson in the room at an overlapping time is a 409 `room-taken` naming it, unless `confirmRoomOverlap` is set; the body is optional. The lesson stays detached from its class. A scheduled lesson stays as it is, started or not.

Puts the signed-in person or one of their dependents at the end of the waiting list of a full lesson. Whenever a place frees, the oldest waiting entry is invited by mail; the invite reserves the place until `expiresAt`. With `stayOnList`, an invite the person lets expire or declines puts them back at the end of the list instead of ending the entry. A person outside the family, or a lesson the caller may not see, is a 404; a lesson that cannot be booked a 409 `closed` with `why`, as in `bookLesson`. A person booked already is a 409 `already-booked`, one on the list already a 409 `already-waiting`, and a lesson with a free place (`freePlaces` > 0) a 409 `not-full`: book it instead.

get.description: Returns all locations of the school ordered by name.

post.description: Adds a location. A name another location has (ignoring case) is a 409 `duplicate`.

delete.description: Deletes a location without rooms; one with rooms is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and address of a location. A name another location has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Returns the active calendar feeds of the signed-in account, oldest first. Their links cannot be shown again: only a hash of the token is stored.

post.description: Creates the subscription link of a subject: `bookings` (the lessons the account and its dependents are booked for), `teaching` (the lessons of the account's staff records; staff only, else 403) or `schedule` (the schedule as the account sees it, of one location with `locationId`; an unknown location is a 422). An account has one link per subject: a new one revokes the old. The token and the link are in this response only. Not while an admin is signed in as the account (403).

delete.description: Revokes an active feed of the signed-in account: its link answers 404 from now on.

get.description: Returns the active bookings of the signed-in person and their dependents (managed ones included) in lessons that are not over, by start, and their open waiting-list entries of lessons that have not started, with their place in the list or their invite. A booking is listed whatever its lesson's visibility: a hidden or unreleased lesson the family is booked for is still theirs. Canceled bookings are not listed here; the history has them once their lessons are over.

Returns one page of the bookings of the signed-in person and their dependents, canceled ones included, in lessons that are over: those that started in the 3 calendar months (in the school time zone) before `before` (default and at most: now), the newest first. The next page is `before` = `nextBefore`, as long as `hasMore` says there are older bookings; a page in between may be empty.

parameters.description: End of the page (exclusive): it holds the lessons that started in the months before this instant; default and at most: now.
parameters.name: before

schema.description: End of the page (exclusive): it holds the lessons that started in the months before this instant; default and at most: now.

delete.description: Deletes a room that no class or lesson uses; a used one is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the location, name and capacity of a room. Existing lessons keep their capacity. A name another room of the location has is a 409 `duplicate`.

get.description: Returns the lessons that start in a range of school dates, as the caller may see them. Visitors who are not signed in see public lessons that are released, plus workshops and private lessons, which are published early. Members also see lessons for members, and regular lessons up to visibleUntil (early access). Staff see every lesson, hidden and unreleased ones included. Canceled lessons are included with their status. Each lesson comes with its free places and, for a signed-in caller, whom of their family it has booked.

Returns the active instructors and accompanists ordered by display name.

post.description: Adds an instructor or accompanist, optionally linked to a person. An unknown person is a 422 on `personId`.

get.description: Returns the persons whose given or family name contains every word of `q` (at least two characters), ignoring case, ordered by family and given name; at most 20. Only the name and the birth year, no contact data: for instructors and accompanists adding a person to their lesson (`addLessonParticipant`). The office's picker is `listPersons`.

delete.description: Deletes a staff member that no class or lesson refers to; a referenced one is a 409 `in-use` and can be deactivated instead.

put.description: Replaces the name, kind, person link and active flag of a staff member. Inactive staff leave the public staff list and the schedule filters but stay on their lessons.

get.description: Returns the lessons that start in a range of school dates, by default the week before today, today and the week after (at most 31 days), with their counts and attendance state. An instructor or accompanist gets the lessons their active staff records (linked to their person) teach or accompany, none without a link; the office every lesson. `staffId` keeps one staff member's lessons (for an instructor, only their own). Canceled and hidden lessons are included.

get.description: Returns all terms ordered by start date.

post.description: Adds a term. Terms may overlap, and their names need not be unique.

delete.description: Deletes a term without classes; a term with classes is a 409 `in-use`.

put.description: Replaces the name and dates of a term. The lessons of its classes that the new dates leave out are deleted while they lie ahead, still follow their class and have no bookings; any other lesson left out is a 422 on `startsOn` or `endsOn`, whichever leaves it out. Longer dates get the lessons that lie ahead.

get.description: Returns the weekly classes of a term ordered by weekday (Sunday first) and start time, without retired classes.
get.summary: List the classes of a term

post.description: Adds a weekly class to a term and generates its lessons that lie ahead. An unknown course type, room or staff member is a 422 on the field that names it.

get.description: Returns what the link of a `waitlist-invite` mail stands for: the lesson, the given name of the person the place is reserved for, until when, and whether it can still be taken (`state`, `closed`); after an invite that ended while the person went back to the list, `state` is `waiting` with their `position`. It changes nothing, so mail scanners that open links take no place. No sign-in is needed; an unknown token is a 404. Rate-limited per client.

parameters.description: The token from the invite link.
parameters.name: token

schema.description: The token from the invite link.

post.description: Books the place the invite holds without a sign-in, the token being the proof, and returns the invite as it is now (`state` accepted). It fails like `acceptWaitlistInvite`; the link of an entry that went back to waiting is a 409 `invite-expired`, an unknown token (or a link that a newer invite replaced) a 404. The confirmation goes to the person's mail recipients, like the invite. Rate-limited per client.

delete.description: Takes an entry of the signed-in person or one of their dependents off the list (404 for any other entry); a place its invite held goes to the next entry. An entry that is no longer on the list is a 409 `not-waiting`.

post.description: Books the place an invite of the signed-in person or one of their dependents holds (404 for any other entry), like `bookLesson`, and returns the booking. A waiting entry is a 409 `not-invited`, an invite that ran out a 409 `invite-expired`, one used already (accepted, or the entry left the list) a 409 `invite-used`; a lesson that cannot be booked any more a 409 `closed` with `why`. The signed-in account gets the confirmation mail.

Gives up the place an invite holds, failing like `acceptWaitlistInvite`; the place goes to the next entry. An entry with `stayOnList` goes back to the end of the list (while booking is open), any other ends. Returns the entry as it is now.

get.description: Returns the iCalendar document (RFC 5545) of a feed, as its account may see it now: the lessons from four weeks back on, in the school's time zone, canceled ones with `STATUS:CANCELLED`. The token is the proof; no sign-in is needed. An unknown or revoked token, or the feed of a disabled account, is a 404. With the `ETag` in `If-None-Match` an unchanged feed is a 304. `download=true` asks for an attachment with a file name. Rate-limited per client, generously since calendar services poll from shared addresses, and per feed.
